;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–present)|War in Afghanistan]]
**A highway is closed and power is shut off in parts of [[Helmand Province]] amidst brutal fighting in which 71 [[Taliban]] fighters have been killed and the deputy shadow governor of Helmand, Mawlawi Ghafoor, has been arrested. The governor's office says that Ghafoor was recently released as part of [[Afghan peace process|peace negotiations]]. [https://tolonews.com/afghanistan-166984 (TOLO News)]

;Business and economy
*[[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on aviation]]
**[[British Airways]] [[CEO]] [[Álex Cruz (businessman)|Álex Cruz]] is [[dismissal (employment)|fired]] as the airline struggles with both reduced passengers caused by the [[COVID-19 pandemic]], and heavy criticisms from [[labour union]]s and [[Member of Parliament (United Kingdom)|MPs]] for massive firings and large pay cuts. [[Sean Doyle (businessman)|Sean Doyle]], CEO of [[Republic of Ireland|Irish]] [[flag carrier]] [[Aer Lingus]], immediately assumes his position. [https://www.bbc.com/news/business-54505840 (BBC News)]
*[[Nobel Prize in Economics|The Sveriges Riksbank Prize in Economic Sciences in Memory of Alfred Nobel]]
**The [[Sveriges Riksbank]] Prize in [[Economic Sciences]] in Memory of [[Alfred Nobel]] goes to [[Paul Milgrom|Paul R. Milgrom]] and [[Robert B. Wilson]] “for improvements to auction theory and inventions of new auction formats.” [https://www.cnn.com/2020/10/12/business/nobel-prize-economics/index.html (CNN)]

;Disasters and accidents
*A massive [[power failure]] in [[Mumbai]], [[India]], believed to be caused by an issue with the main [[electrical grid|power grid]] receiving electricity, leaves millions of people without power and brings the city's [[Public transport in Mumbai|rail lines]] to a standstill. [[List of chief ministers of Maharashtra|Maharashtra Chief Minister]] [[Uddhav Thackeray]] orders an investigation into the cause. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-54505643?__twitter_impression=true (BBC News)] [https://www.ndtv.com/india-news/major-power-outage-in-mumbai-due-to-incoming-electric-supply-failure-2308740 (NDTV)]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Washington, D.C.]]
****[[White House COVID-19 outbreak]]
*****[[Sean Conley|Dr. Sean Conley]] reports that [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] has tested negative for COVID-19 on consecutive days. Conley also said  the President was no longer a risk of spreading the virus to others. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2020-10-13/donald-trump-tests-negative-for-coroanvirus-says-doctor/12760446 (ABC Australia)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ohio]]
****[[Ohio]] reaches 5,000 COVID-19 deaths. [https://www.cincinnati.com/story/news/2020/10/12/ohio-hits-5-000-dead-in-coronavirus-covid-19-pandemic/3594214001/ (Cincinnati News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Hawaii]]
****[[Hawaii]] reports 42 cases, the lowest in the state since July 24. [https://www.hawaiinewsnow.com/2020/10/12/state-reports-just-new-covid-cases-lowest-number-since-july/ (Hawaii News Now)] [https://www.hawaiitribune-herald.com/2020/10/12/hawaii-news/doh-42-new-covid-19-caes-statewide-no-new-deaths/ (''Hawaii Tribune-Herald'')]

**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Malaysia]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Kuala Lumpur]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in Selangor]]
*****Following a rapid increase in the number of COVID-19 cases in [[Malaysia]], the [[Government of Malaysia|federal government]] announces that [[Kuala Lumpur]], [[Selangor]], and [[Putrajaya]] will be put under a [[2020 Malaysia movement control order|Conditional Movement Control Order]] (CMCO). The tightened restrictions will be enforced between October 14 and October 27. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/covid-19-malaysia-cmco-kuala-lumpur-selangor-putrajaya-13263154 (CNA)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Sabah]]
*****It is announced that all of [[Sabah]] will put under Conditional Movement Control Order between tomorrow at 12:01 a.m. local time and October 26. Under these restrictions, only two people per household will be allowed to go out to buy necessities. In addition, schools, public parks, recreational centers, tahfiz centers, and others will be closed. [https://www.nst.com.my/amp/news/nation/2020/10/631673/sabah-placed-under-cmco-oct-13-26 (''New Straits Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iran]]
****For the second day in a row, [[Iran]] reports a single day record high of 272 new COVID-19 fatalities as, at the same time, the country registers 4,206 new cases in the last 24 hours, the highest number since start of the pandemic. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/iran-announces-highest-daily-death-toll-patient-count-73559747 (ABC News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Israel]]
****[[Israel]] surpasses 2,000 COVID-19 deaths as the country remains in [[COVID-19 pandemic lockdowns|lockdown]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/israel-passes-2000-covid-19-deaths-doubling-its-toll-in-just-5-weeks/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China]]
****Authorities in [[Qingdao]] say that they will test the entire population of more than nine million people for COVID-19 in the next five days, after new cases appeared linked to Qingdao Chest Hospital, which was treating people confirmed with the disease after returning from overseas. [https://m.medcom.id/internasional/asia-pasifik/ybDV7nRK-kota-qingdao-di-tiongkok-siapkan-9-juta-tes-covid-19 (Medcom.id)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in England]]
*****[[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|Prime Minister]] [[Boris Johnson]] unveils a new three-tier restrictions system aimed to simplify the range of different restrictions already in place across various parts of [[England]]. The Local COVID Alert Levels ("medium", "high", and "very high") will be implemented in different areas depending on local infection rates.  [https://news.sky.com/story/coronavirus-boris-johnson-confirms-new-three-tier-system-of-local-lockdowns-for-england-12102599 (Sky News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Andorra]]
****[[Executive Council of Andorra|Minister of Finances]] [[Èric Jover]] tests positive for COVID-19 and becomes the first Andorran high-profile politician to get infected. [https://www.diariandorra.ad/noticies/nacional/2020/10/12/el_ministre_jover_dona_positiu_per_coronavirus_168215_1125.html (''Diari d'Andorra'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Czech Republic]]
****To prevent the fast spread of COVID-19, which is among the highest in Europe, [[Ministry of Health (Czech Republic)|Health Minister]] [[Roman Prymula]] announces on Twitter that the [[Government of the Czech Republic|Czech government]] has ordered bars, restaurants, and clubs closed between October 14 and November 3, and most schools must shift to distance learning. In addition, public gatherings will also be restricted to six people, alcohol consumption in public spaces is banned, and masks are required at public transport stops. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-czech-idUSKBN26X2IZ (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Russia]]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in Russia]]
*****[[Russia]] says that it has started [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]] trials for their [[Gam-COVID-Vac]] [[Sputnik V COVID-19 vaccine|Sputnik V]] vaccine in the [[United Arab Emirates]]. The announcement comes after [[President of Russia|President]] [[Vladimir Putin]] had a phone call with [[Emirate of Abu Dhabi|Abu Dhabi]] Crown Prince [[Mohammed bin Zayed Al Nahyan]]. [https://www.cnbc.com/2020/10/12/russias-coronavirus-vaccine-human-trials-begin-in-the-middle-east.html (CNBC)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Vatican City]]
****Four members of the Vatican [[Swiss Guard]] test positive for COVID-19, becoming the first positive cases since June. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/covid-19-four-vatican-swiss-guards-test-positive-covid-19-n1242928 (NBC News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in French Polynesia]]
****French Polynesian [[President of French Polynesia|President]] [[Edouard Fritch]] tests positive for COVID-19 after returning from France. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/428117/french-polynesia-president-tests-covid-19-positive (RNZI)] [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/428212/macron-not-contact-case-after-meeting-tahiti-s-fritch (RNZI)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in South America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Argentina]]
****The number of cases in [[Argentina]] exceeds 900,000. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-argentina-idUSKBN26Y02X (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 vaccine]]
***[[Indonesia]] aims to start administering COVID-19 [[vaccine]]s early next month, according to the Coordinating Ministry for Maritime and Investment Affairs. [[Sinopharm]] and G42 Healthcare will supply five million doses starting next month, [[CanSino Biologics]] will supply 100,000 doses that same time, and [[Sinovac]] will supply three million doses of [[CoronaVac]] by December. All three vaccines are currently in [[Phase III trials]] in various countries. [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/se-asia/indonesia-aims-to-start-administering-coronavirus-vaccines-in-early-november (''The Straits Times'')]
***[[Johnson & Johnson]] has paused the [[Phase III trials]] of its COVID-19 vaccine because of an unexplained illness in one of the volunteers. [https://www.cnn.com/2020/10/12/health/johnson-coronavirus-vaccine-pause-bn/index.html (CNN)]

;Law and crime
*[[Face masks during the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Wisconsin]]
***Circuit Court Judge R. Michael Waterman refuses to block the mask mandate order by Wisconsin [[Governor of Wisconsin|Governor]] [[Tony Evers]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2020/10/12/us/wisconsin-mask-mandate-lawsuit-declined-trnd/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Capital punishment in Bangladesh]]
**[[Bangladesh]] plans to introduce the [[death penalty]] for [[rape]], following days of protests about the country's high level of [[sexual violence]] [[violence against women|against women]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-54480233 (BBC News)]
*[[Amy Coney Barrett Supreme Court nomination]]
**21 protesters are arrested in [[Washington, D.C.]] during the first day of confirmation hearings for [[Associate Justice of the Supreme Court of the United States|Associate Supreme Court Justice]] nominee [[Amy Coney Barrett]]. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/local/supreme-court-protest/2020/10/12/f9cd3bac-0c8e-11eb-b1e8-16b59b92b36d_story.html (''Washington Post'')]
*[[U.S. state and local government responses to the COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Michigan]]
***The [[Michigan Supreme Court]] announces that it has struck down emergency orders from [[Governor of Michigan|Governor]] [[Gretchen Whitmer]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2020/10/12/politics/michigan-supreme-court-whitmer-covid-emergency/index.html (CNN)]
*[[2020 Belarusian protests]]
**The [[Ministry of Internal Affairs (Belarus)|Interior Ministry]] of [[Belarus]] grants the police the authority to use lethal weapons against anti-[[Alexander Lukashenko|Lukashenko]] protesters if needed. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-54513568 (BBC News)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2020 Lithuanian parliamentary election]]
**Early data shows the oppositional [[Homeland Union]] victorious in the first round of the latest [[Elections in Lithuania|parliamentary election]] in [[Lithuania]]. The second round will be held on October 25. [https://www.dw.com/en/lithuanias-conservative-opposition-tops-initial-election-vote/a-55240212 (DW)]
*[[2020 Philippine House of Representatives leadership crisis]]
**A majority of members of the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] elect [[Lord Allan Jay Velasco]] as [[Speaker of the House of Representatives of the Philippines|Speaker of the House of Representatives]], unseating incumbent [[Alan Peter Cayetano]] amidst the political dispute over the Speakership outside the Session Hall of the [[Batasang Pambansa Complex]]. Cayetano declares Velasco's election as "illegal" and maintains that he is the Speaker. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/philippines-congress-cayetano-velasco-house-speaker-13263200 (AP via CNA)]
*[[2020 Tajik presidential election]]
**Long-term [[President of Tajikistan|President]] [[Emomali Rakhmon]] is declared the victor of [[Tajikistan]]'s latest [[Elections in Tajikistan|presidential election]] with over 90% of the votes. [https://www.dw.com/en/emomali-rakhmon-wins-tajikistan-election-with-more-than-90-of-vote/a-55238879 (DW)]
